landing.heroTagline: Trading Discipline Platform for MT5 Traders
landing.heroTitle: 80% of traders fail because they break their own rules.
landing.heroSubtitle: TradifyApp enforces your trading rules, tracks drawdown in real time, and stops revenge trading before it costs you the challenge.
landing.sectionsTitle: Built for clarity, discipline, and long-term performance
landing.soundFamiliarSubtitle: Every trader hits these walls. TradifyApp was built to break through them.
landing.persona1Body: You hit your drawdown limit without realizing it. You lose track of your profit target. One bad day wipes out a week of progress — and you didn't even see it coming. TradifyApp tracks every challenge rule in real time so you always know exactly where you stand.
landing.persona2Title: "I can't stop breaking my own rules"
landing.persona2Body: You wrote the rules. You know they work. But in the heat of the moment, you skip them — revenge trade, overtrade, move your stop loss. TradifyApp validates every trade against your strategy before it counts, turning your rules into a system you actually follow.
landing.persona3Title: "I don't journal because it's too much work"
landing.persona3Body: You know journaling works, but manually logging trades after every session? Nobody has time for that. So you skip it, lose the data, and repeat the same mistakes. TradifyApp auto-syncs every trade from MT5 — zero manual entry, zero excuses.

landing.stepsSubtitle: No complex setup. No broker credentials shared. Just connect and start tracking.
landing.step1Body: Sign up free in 30 seconds. No credit card required. Pick your plan later.
landing.step2Body: Install our free Expert Advisor on MT5. It reads your trades automatically — read-only, no broker access needed.
landing.step3Body: Every trade auto-syncs. Set your rules. Track your prop firm. Watch your discipline improve.
landing.leadMagnetSubtitle: The exact 12-point checklist disciplined prop traders use before every entry. Drop your email — we'll send the PDF.
landing.leadMagnetSuccess: Check your email — the checklist is on its way.
landing.calcSubtitle: Plug in your account size, drawdown %, and profit target. We'll show you exactly what you need to do to pass.
landing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
landing.ctaFinalSubtitle: Start your free TradifyApp account in 30 seconds. No credit card required.
landing.notForYouTitle: TradifyApp is not for you if…
landing.notForYouItem1: You want signals, alerts or trade ideas — we don't tell you what to trade.
landing.notForYouItem2: You want a copy-trading or auto-execution bot — we never touch your trades.
landing.notForYouItem3: You're not willing to write your own rules — we enforce yours, not ours.
landing.everyProblemSubtitle: Real trader problems. Real solutions. No fluff.

about.title: About TradifyApp
about.subtitle: Built by a prop trader who lost too many challenges to undisciplined trading.
about.missionBody: Help traders enforce the rules they already wrote — so the only thing standing between them and a funded account is the market, not themselves.
about.value1Body: We don't tell you what to trade. We help you stick to what you already decided.
about.value2Body: We never auto-execute, never share your trades. You stay in full control.
about.value3Body: Every feature was born from a real losing trade or a real prop challenge fail.
